title: CI-4: Add helper lookups to existing build/artifact/deployment repos
description: Extend existing repositories with lookup methods needed for pipeline bridge idempotency. 1) internal/repository/pg_build.go: add GetByCISystemRunID(ctx, ciSystem, ciRunID) — uses existing UNIQUE(ci_system, ci_run_id) constraint. 2) internal/repository/pg_artifact.go: add GetByImageRepoDigest(ctx, imageRepo, imageDigest) — uses existing UNIQUE(image_repo, image_digest) constraint. 3) internal/repository/pg_deployment.go: add GetByHiveResultEventID(ctx, eventID) — uses new metadata JSONB lookup with partial unique index from migration 000013. These enable the bridge to safely reuse existing records on retry/reprocessing. Add tests for each new method. Depends on CI-1 (migration for deployment_intents index).

title: CI-3: Add Hive-CI Nostr event subscriber
description: Add internal/adapters/hiveci/subscriber.go. Subscribe to kind 5401 (Workflow Run) and 5402 (Workflow Result) events on configured fleet relays. On 5401: parse required tags (a, commit, branch, workflow, triggered-by, publisher), verify event signature, persist via HiveCIRepository, log for audit. On 5402: parse required tags (e reference to 5401, log_url, status, exit_code, duration), verify event signature, validate ephemeral publisher key relationship (5401.publisher == 5402.pubkey), persist result, trigger bridge consumer. Filter by trusted_ci_pubkeys from config (5401 must be signed by trusted dispatcher). Integrate with existing relay pool from internal/adapters/nostr/relay_pool.go. Register in internal/app/background.go lifecycle. Add subscriber_test.go covering tag parsing and publisher validation. Shippable outcome: audited CI event ingestion with no build/deploy side effects yet. Depends on CI-2.

title: CI-2: Implement HiveCIRepository persistence layer
description: Add internal/repository/pg_hiveci.go implementing HiveCIRepository interface. Methods: UpsertWorkflowRun (idempotent by event_id), UpsertWorkflowResult (idempotent by event_id), GetRunByEventID, GetResultByEventID, ListPendingResults (results awaiting bridge processing), UpdateResultState (pending→verified→processed transitions), ListPolicies, GetPolicyByRepoAndWorkflow. State machine: pending_run (5401 seen, no 5402 yet) → pending_result (5402 seen) → verified (signature/publisher validated) → processed (build/artifact created) or rejected/failed. Add pg_hiveci_test.go covering all state transitions and idempotency. Depends on CI-1.

title: CI-1: Add pipeline config, Hive-CI domain types, and database migration
description: Add groundwork for Hive-CI ingestion. 1) New 'pipeline' config section: enabled flag, relay list, auto_register_builds, auto_deploy_staging, staging_environment name, trusted_ci_pubkeys list. 2) New internal/domain/hiveci.go with types: HiveCIWorkflowRun (repo coordinate, commit, branch, workflow path, trigger type, triggered_by, publisher pubkey), HiveCIWorkflowResult (status, exit_code, duration, log_url, error), HiveCIPipelinePolicy (maps Hive-CI repo/workflow to Bahia service/environment), processing state enum (pending_run/pending_result/verified/rejected/processed/failed). 3) New migration 000013_hiveci_pipeline with tables: hiveci_workflow_runs (kind 5401 data), hiveci_workflow_results (kind 5402 data), hiveci_pipeline_policies (repo→service mapping), plus a partial unique index on deployment_intents.metadata for idempotent auto-intent creation.

title: OCI-9: Registry auth hardening — service accounts, NIP-98, anonymous pull
description: Complete registry authentication and authorization. 1) Basic auth service accounts: config-based accounts with bcrypt password_hash, permission list (pull/push), and repo_prefixes. First account: hive-ci with push+pull to cascadia/. 2) NIP-98 push auth: reuse/extract NIP-98 verifier from internal/auth/nip98.go, validate signed auth events for push operations. 3) Anonymous internal pull: allow unauthenticated pull from configured CIDR ranges (allow_anonymous_pull_cidrs, default 192.168.40.0/24 for VLAN 40). 4) Trusted proxy handling: trusted_proxy_cidrs for X-Forwarded-For extraction behind nginx/cloudflared. Add tests for each auth path. Shippable outcome: fully writable internal OCI registry. Depends on OCI-5.

title: OCI-8: Implement manifest PUT (push) endpoint
description: Add manifest push to registry handler and service. PUT /v2/{name}/manifests/{reference} — accept manifest body, compute sha256 digest from exact bytes, parse manifest JSON to extract: mediaType, config descriptor, layer descriptors (blob_digests), annotations, optional subject (for referrers), optional artifactType. Validate all referenced blobs exist in the repo (oci_repo_blobs). Store manifest content as BYTEA in oci_manifests. If reference is a tag, upsert oci_tags row. Return 201 with Location and Docker-Content-Digest headers. Support OCI image manifest, OCI image index, and Docker v2 manifest media types. Enforce push authorization. Add tests. Depends on OCI-7.

title: OCI-7: Implement blob upload endpoints (POST/PATCH/PUT)
description: Add blob upload HTTP endpoints to registry handler. POST /v2/{name}/blobs/uploads/ — initiate upload session, return Location header with upload UUID, support cross-repo blob mount via mount+from query params. PATCH /v2/{name}/blobs/uploads/{uuid} — append chunk to upload, validate Content-Range, update offset. PUT /v2/{name}/blobs/uploads/{uuid}?digest=... — finalize upload, accept optional final chunk, verify computed digest matches expected, upload assembled blob to Blossom, finalize in DB, return 201 with Location. Add monolithic POST fast-path (single-request upload). Enforce push authorization. Add integration tests. Depends on OCI-3 (Blossom streaming upload), OCI-5 (handler), OCI-6 (sessions).

title: OCI-6: Implement upload session persistence and spool handling
description: Add blob upload session management. Persistence: oci_blob_uploads table operations via OCIRegistryRepository (create, get, update offset, mark failed/expired, delete). Spool handling: temp file lifecycle in configured spool_dir (/srv/data/bahia/oci-uploads), chunk appending to temp files, cleanup on finalization or failure. Background cleanup: add expired upload cleanup loop to internal/app/background.go, configurable expiry (default 24h). Add tests for upload session state machine transitions. Depends on OCI-1, OCI-2.

title: OCI-5: Mount /v2 routes, handler, and registry auth middleware
description: Add internal/api/handlers/registry.go with OCI Distribution handler. Key routing: register GET/HEAD /v2/ plus wildcard /v2/* and parse repo name + suffix manually (repo names contain slashes, cannot use standard chi params). Suffixes: /manifests/{reference}, /blobs/{digest}, /tags/list, /referrers/{digest}. Add internal/api/middleware/registry_auth.go resolving RegistryPrincipal from NIP-98, basic auth, or anonymous. Extract reusable NIP-98 verifier from internal/auth/nip98.go if needed. Wire routes in internal/api/router/router.go. Return OCI-spec error responses (application/json with code/message/detail). Add registry_test.go with integration tests for pull operations. Shippable outcome: pull-only registry for preseeded content. Depends on OCI-4.

title: OCI-4: Implement OCIRegistryService read operations
description: Add internal/service/oci_registry.go with OCIRegistryService implementing read-only registry operations: CheckAPI (returns registry ping result with Docker-Distribution-API-Version header), FetchManifest (by tag or digest, validates Accept header compatibility, returns exact manifest bytes with Content-Type + Docker-Content-Digest + Content-Length), ProxyBlobGET/HEAD (proxy from Blossom with correct OCI headers), ListTags (paginated, returns OCI tags/list response), ListReferrers (returns OCI referrers index filtered by artifact_type). Enforces pull authorization based on repo visibility and RegistryPrincipal. Depends on OCI-2 (repository) and OCI-3 (Blossom proxy).

title: OCI-3: Extend Blossom adapter for registry blob proxy
description: Extend internal/adapters/blossom/ to support the OCI registry's blob storage needs. Add to upload.go: streaming/file upload method that does not require loading full blob into memory, returns BlobDescriptor with resolved URL/size/hash. Add to download.go: HEAD helper (check blob existence + get Content-Length), open-stream-by-URL helper for proxying GET responses to HTTP clients. These are required because OCI blob uploads can be large (container layers) and the pull path must proxy Blossom bytes/headers transparently. Add tests for new methods.

title: OCI-2: Implement OCIRegistryRepository persistence layer
description: Add internal/repository/pg_oci.go implementing the OCIRegistryRepository interface. Methods: EnsureRepository, GetRepository, GetManifestByDigest, GetManifestByTag, PutManifest (manifest insert + tag upsert in single tx), GetBlob, BlobExistsInRepo, FinalizeBlob, CreateUpload, GetUpload, UpdateUploadOffset, MarkUploadFailed, ListExpiredUploads, DeleteUpload, ListTags (paginated with 'last' cursor), ListReferrers (filtered by subject_digest and optional artifact_type). Add interface to internal/repository/interfaces.go. Add pg_oci_test.go covering all CRUD operations. Depends on OCI-1 (migration + domain types).

title: OCI-1: Add registry config, domain types, and database migration
description: Add the groundwork for the OCI registry server subsystem. Includes: 1) New 'registry' config section in internal/config/config.go with enabled flag, public_host, spool_dir, upload_expiry, allow_anonymous_pull_cidrs, authorized_push_pubkeys, and service_accounts. 2) New internal/domain/oci.go with OCIRepository, OCIManifest, OCIBlob, OCIBlobUpload, OCIReferrerDescriptor, and RegistryPrincipal types. 3) New migration 000012_oci_registry with tables: oci_repositories, oci_manifests, oci_tags, oci_blobs, oci_repo_blobs, oci_blob_uploads. Manifests stored as BYTEA (digest depends on exact bytes). Blob digests denormalized in manifests for validation. Acceptance: config parses, migration runs, domain types compile.

title: Hive-CI Integration & Pipeline Bridge
description: Bahia needs to ingest Hive-CI workflow events (kind 5401/5402), auto-register builds and artifacts from CI results, and optionally auto-create deployment intents to staging. Covers: Hive-CI event subscription and validation, pipeline bridge logic mapping CI results to Bahia domain models (Build/Artifact/DeploymentIntent), auto-deploy staging policy, retry/idempotency handling, and protocol contract updates. Depends on OCI Registry Server epic for artifact verification.

title: OCI Registry Server — Bahia as internal container registry
description: Bahia needs to serve OCI Distribution Spec v2 endpoints, becoming the fleet's internal container registry at registry.sharegap.net. Currently the registry layer is client-only (inspects external registries). This epic adds server-side OCI endpoints with PostgreSQL for manifest/tag metadata and Blossom as the blob storage backend. Phases: 1) Config/domain/migration groundwork, 2) Read path (manifest/blob/tags/referrers pull), 3) Write path (blob upload, manifest push), 4) Auth hardening (NIP-98 push, anonymous internal pull, service accounts).

title: CI-10: End-to-end validation — registry push through staging deploy
description: Validate the full CI/CD flow end-to-end. Test sequence: 1) Push an OCI image to registry.sharegap.net via docker push or oras push. 2) Verify manifest and blobs stored correctly (manifest in PostgreSQL, blobs in Blossom). 3) Pull the image back and verify digest matches. 4) Publish a trusted kind 5401 Workflow Run event to fleet relays. 5) Publish a matching kind 5402 Workflow Result with success status and correct image_repo/image_tag/image_digest tags. 6) Verify Bahia auto-created Build row with correct fields. 7) Verify Bahia auto-created Artifact row linked to pushed manifest. 8) Verify Bahia auto-created DeploymentIntent for staging environment. 9) Verify existing Loom deployment path picks up the intent and creates a deployment run. 10) Test error cases: publisher mismatch rejection, missing image rejection, duplicate event idempotency. Can be implemented as integration test suite or manual validation script.

title: CI-9: Update Bahia and Hive-CI protocol documentation
description: Update all affected documentation. Bahia docs: 1) README.md — add OCI registry server and Hive-CI bridge to feature list. 2) docs/api.md — add OCI /v2 endpoint section (outside /api/v1). 3) docs/architecture.md — add OCI registry brain/blob-store split diagram and CI bridge flow. 4) docs/deployment.md — add registry config, spool_dir, service accounts, Blossom dependency. 5) docs/protocol-compatibility.md — add OCI Distribution server role and Hive-CI 5401/5402 inbound consumption. 6) docs/event-spec.md — document that Hive-CI events produce normal Bahia audit events. Hive-CI protocol (cross-repo): 7) hive-ci-protocol/SPECIFICATION.md — add required Bahia integration tags to 5402 spec: image_repo, image_tag, image_digest, loom_job_id. 8) hive-ci-protocol/README.md — reference Bahia registry integration.

title: CI-8: Wire background retry loop for pending CI results
description: Add background retry processing for Hive-CI results stuck in intermediate states. Add to internal/app/background.go: periodic loop (configurable interval, default 30s) that queries HiveCIRepository.ListPendingResults for results in states: pending_run (5402 received but 5401 not yet seen — may arrive out of order), artifact_pending (image not yet in registry when first processed). For each pending result: re-run bridge processing. Track retry_count and last_retry_at. Apply exponential backoff with max_retries (default 10). Move to 'failed' state after exhausting retries. Add tests for retry state machine, backoff behavior, and max retry exhaustion. Depends on CI-5, CI-6.

title: CI-7: Add auto-deploy staging policy to pipeline bridge
description: Extend pipeline bridge to auto-create DeploymentIntents for staging. After artifact registration (CI-6), if pipeline policy has auto_deploy_staging=true: 1) Resolve target environment from policy (e.g. edge-01-staging). 2) Create DeploymentIntent with: service_id, environment_id, artifact_id, requested_by='hive-ci-bridge', source_kind='event_triggered'. 3) Use metadata-based idempotency key (hive_result_event_id stored in intent metadata JSONB) with the partial unique index from migration 000013. 4) For protected environments: set approval_status to 'pending'. 5) For unprotected staging: set to 'not_required' and let existing deployment machinery auto-execute. 6) Do NOT auto-promote to production — that requires explicit human approval. Add tests for: staging auto-deploy, protected env → pending approval, duplicate intent → reused, no auto-deploy policy → skipped. Shippable outcome: full CI → staging intent bridge. Depends on CI-6.

title: CI-6: Extend pipeline bridge for artifact registration
description: Extend internal/pipeline/bridge.go to handle artifact creation from CI results. After build registration (CI-5), for successful builds: 1) Extract image_repo, image_tag, image_digest from Hive-CI result metadata tags (these are new required tags in the 5402 contract). 2) Look up manifest in Bahia's OCI registry via OCIRegistryRepository to verify the image was actually pushed. 3) If manifest exists: create/reuse Artifact via GetByImageRepoDigest, link to build, set metadata. 4) If manifest not yet available (push still propagating): set result state to 'artifact_pending' for retry. 5) On failure results: skip artifact registration, build stays with failed status. Add tests covering: success with image present → artifact created, success with image missing → artifact_pending, failure → no artifact, duplicate artifact → reused. Shippable outcome: CI results produce builds + artifacts. Depends on CI-5, OCI Registry (bahia-2kk) for manifest lookup.

title: CI-5: Implement pipeline bridge — build registration from CI results
description: Add internal/pipeline/bridge.go with PipelineBridge service implementing the core CI-to-deploy orchestration. Build-only path for this issue. On receiving a verified Hive-CI result: 1) Match result to a pipeline policy (maps repo coordinate + workflow to Bahia service). No policy match → log and skip. 2) Validate trusted dispatcher (5401 signer in trusted_ci_pubkeys). 3) Validate publisher match (5401.publisher == 5402.pubkey). 4) Map CI result to Bahia Build: service_id from policy, git_sha from 5401.commit, git_ref from 5401.branch, ci_system='hive-ci', ci_run_id=5401.event_id, status mapped from 5402.status (success→succeeded, failure→failed). 5) Create or reuse Build via GetByCISystemRunID. 6) Update result state to 'processed'. Add bridge_test.go covering: trusted dispatcher + matching publisher, publisher mismatch rejection, no policy → ignored, success → build created, failure → build created with failed status, duplicate/retry idempotency. Shippable outcome: CI results show up as Bahia builds. Depends on CI-3, CI-4.
